content:
liam_supply: Quick heads-up — Vendor Dawn sent an updated rate card and allocation proposal for EMEA. They want to convert 8 reserved H100s (Q2 commit) into a 4-now + 4-30d split, with a spot uplift on the 4 delayed units.
vendor_dawn: Sorry for the ping. Two things: 1) we have 4 units available for immediate air, 2) 4 units are pending customs reclass + need RMA split (2 DOA at depot). Proposed uplift: +9% on the delayed tranche if you accept split shipping.
maria_ops: Is the uplift for shipping only or unit pricing too? Need numbers for finance.
vendor_dawn: Uplift covers expedited air + handling + temporary loaners for the 2 DOA. Unit price unchanged. We can provide credit note for confirmed DOA serials.
june_logistics: Where are the 4 delayed units physically? ETA to gateway?
vendor_dawn: At FRA crossdock. Customs flagged HS code mismatch on two line items, so they held 2. ETA release estimate 48–72h if we push with amended docs.
liam_supply: Can we accept 4-now air and have the 4 held go by sea once cleared? Concern is cluster demand spike next week.
alex_sre: If we only take 4 now, our pre-warm pool will be short by ~30% for the US/EMEA rotation — might see latency/queueing on dedicated pools.
maria_ops: Cost vs availability tradeoff — get me the uplift number vs spot procurement from other vendor.
vendor_dawn: Uplift breakdown: +3% handling, +4% expedited air, +2% loaner insurance = 9% total. If you take all 8 as committed (no split) we can waive handling fee (so ~6%).
liam_supply: Can vendor provide temporary loaners for the next 10 days while customs clears? That mitigates SLO risk for us.
vendor_dawn: Yes — we can provide 2 loaners for up to 14 days, subject to serial reconciliation and a refundable deposit. We'll include AWB for loaners.
june_logistics: For RMA: what's the plan for the 2 DOA at depot? We need an RMA manifest and depot repair SLA.
vendor_dawn: Plan: immediate depot repair for the DOA pair (RMA IDs to follow). If depot can't repair within 7 days we swap with replacement units breadboarded from EU pool. We'll ship repaired units back consolidated.
procure_bot: PO 45981 matched to vendor invoice draft v3 — requires amendment if split shipment changes charge codes.
maria_ops: @procure_bot please calculate expected invoice delta for +9% uplift on 4 units vs full 8 at +6% waiver. Need for FP&A.
procure_bot: Calculating... draft delta = roughly €28,900 uplift across the 4 expedited units (est). Will attach breakdown in procurement tracker.
liam_supply: Logistics question: AWB for the immediate 4? Need port vs airport choice. Air is costly but faster.
june_logistics: Air to CDG or FRA? We prefer FRA gateway into our EU racks; CDG has higher terminal fees currently.
vendor_dawn: We can do FRA air — AWB AF-123456789. ETA FRA sorting 36h after pickup. We can provide tracking.
